title: Coconut rhinoceros beetle detections on Maui
summary: The County held a town hall after CRB finds dating to 17 larvae in Kīhei in 2023, with the latest a dead beetle in a trap; the state said wiping out CRB remains the goal. An invasive species program reported another dead beetle on April 1 and sought more budget help.

timeline.text: On Lānaʻi, CRB was caught three times in large potted plants at a quarantine facility.
A state agriculture official said wiping out CRB is still the goal for Maui County.
The most recent find was one dead beetle in a trap at Home Depot on Monday.
In November 2023, 17 live larvae were found in a dead coconut stump in Kīhei.
CRB has damaged banana, sugar cane, kalo and pineapple plants.
The County of Maui held a town hall on the coconut rhinoceros beetle, also called CRB.
